name: 1password-safe-mcp
description: Run the local 1Password Safe MCP server for listing 1Password items and copying selected fields without returning secret values.

interface.longDescription: Run a local MCP server that lists accessible 1Password vault items, describes fields without values, and copies one selected field to the macOS clipboard without returning the secret to the agent.
defaultPrompt: Use 1Password Safe MCP to find a login.
Copy a selected 1Password field to the clipboard.
